findings.title: 404 page ships without a stylesheet link
findings.description: Next 14 renders the not-found boundary outside every layout when an app has two root layouts. Status 404 and noindex are intact and not-found.tsx rebuilds the chrome and fonts, but CSS arrives via the client chunk.
findings.recommendation: Accept. The proper fix is migrating to app/[locale]/ with a middleware rewrite — a large change for a Low finding.

findings.title: Lighthouse best-practices 96, not 100
findings.description: The only failing audit is a console error from the Cloudflare beacon being blocked by CORS on localhost. A local artifact; does not occur on the real origin.

findings.title: LCP is the only weak metric and the lab cannot measure it reliably
findings.description: Identical builds produced LCP between 2605ms and 4657ms across runs. The LCP element is a hero paragraph whose cost is entirely render delay, not resource loading, pointing at webfont swap timing. An experiment replacing the Inter variable font with static weights and deprioritising the mono face made everything worse (FCP 904 -> 1207ms, CLS 0 -> 0.018) and was reverted.
findings.recommendation: Connect CrUX for field data rather than tuning against lab noise.

findings.title: Correction: the NetworkBackground canvas is not an INP risk
findings.description: Three previous audits flagged it as the likely INP risk on the home page. Measured, TBT is 0 and CLS is 0, and building with the canvas disabled produced a worse LCP (2916ms vs 2610ms) — within run-to-run noise. The hypothesis was wrong.
findings.recommendation: No change needed to the canvas.

limitations: Local build, not production. Security headers confirmed app-level so they carry over; timing does not. Lighthouse best-practices 96 is a localhost CORS artifact.
4 EN and 4 RU blog posts exist only on the live server, so /blog and /ru/blog word counts understate the real site and the 6 duplicate-H1 posts cannot be re-checked locally.
claude-seo toolchain still unavailable (Python 3.9.6, no Homebrew). Lighthouse was run through a separately installed Chromium instead. No PDF report.
No Google, DataForSEO, Moz or Bing credentials: no indexation, ranking, traffic or backlink data in any of the four audits.
